Title: Azure DevTest Labs: Auto-fill virtual machine username and password

Body.Content:
Azure DevTest Labs is introducing features that will reduce the time required for a lab user to create a virtual machine.

When you create a virtual machine as a lab user, the username and password for the machine are now pre-filled. To get a preview and learn more about how this feature works, see the blog post.
